description: Radweg-Hochwassersensor Ulm is a dataset listed in German national open data portal (GovData), an open data portal, published or maintained by Open Data Baden-Württemberg. Dieser Datensatz beinhaltet Daten der Hochwassersensoren am Donauradweg sowie an der Blau in der Stadt Ulm. Zur Ermittlung des Wasserstandes wurde ein Ultraschallsensor über dem Fußgänger/Radweg an der Donau unter der Herdbrücke in Ulm aufgehängt. Dort wird in regelmäßigen Intervallen der Abstand vom Sensor zum Boden via LoRaWAN übermittelt und im Backend ausgewertet. Coverage: Open Data Baden-Württemberg. The portal files it under the publisher Open Data Baden-Württemberg. Its tags are donau, hochwasser, radwege, verkehrsmeldungen. It offers 1 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/JSON. The portal shows 2025-10-03 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-de-portal.
